exposure: Use of ultrasound and/or MRI for diagnosis
Prenatal diagnosis of fetal ovarian cysts
outcome: Rate of cyst regression during pregnancy
Need for surgical treatment in the neonatal period
cohort: 21 neonates prenatally diagnosed with fetal ovarian cysts
finding: Although spontaneous resolution of fetal ovarian cysts is to be expected, the ovarian mass could lead to serious complications if resolution does not occur in due time.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis 31.28 weeks
